scope: Owner-managed signed webhook subscriptions, encrypted and versioned endpoint secrets, durable endpoint/event delivery identity, immutable attempts, separately restartable dispatchers, bounded retry/exhaustion, strict sandbox egress, receiver deduplication and owner/admin inspection. The React product interface remains P08.

requirements.statement: Customers can create, inspect, enable, disable and rotate only their own approved webhook endpoint; secrets are encrypted at rest, returned only on create/rotation and unavailable through ordinary runtime reads.

Each committed eligible event and endpoint creates one durable logical delivery; duplicate fan-out and competing dispatchers cannot create another logical delivery or duplicate a committed attempt identity.

The sender signs the exact transmitted bytes with HMAC-SHA256 over timestamp, event identity and body; the receiver validates the replay window and rejects altered bytes, event identity, key version or signature using constant-time comparison.
Delivery attempts, lease recovery, exponential backoff, eight-attempt exhaustion and audited manual retry cycles survive dispatcher restarts without resetting or erasing immutable history.
Destinations are exact allowlisted endpoints, redirects and unsafe URL/address forms are rejected, and the sandbox receiver durably deduplicates an accepted event when its response is lost.
Owners can inspect only their own deliveries and immutable attempts; administrators can inspect all and request an audited retry without exposing signing secrets.
Webhook dispatch runs in separately restartable bounded processes; receiver failure cannot roll back settled money, modify ledger authority or stop unrelated financial processing.
The scoped OpenAPI, TypeScript client, Java API and live Compose behavior agree on endpoint, delivery, attempt and receiver contracts with no unexplained failures or skips.
